texts.zh:
我们收到科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]的报告。据说有一个……陶瓷容器在围绕着[From.GetName]的恒星旋转。真奇怪。

这种东西不应该出现那儿，然而不管怎样它确实在近地轨道上。

可以发布特殊项目来研究该容器并找出它出现在那里的原因。
texts.en:
We have gotten a report from Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]. It seems that a... ceramic container is circling the star [From.GetName]. Most peculiar.

It should obviously not be there, yet somehow it has managed to find its way into a close orbit.

A Special Project can be issued to investigate the container and try to deduce how it ended up there.

label.zh: 不是所有问题都得有答案。
label.en: All questions don't have worthwhile answers.
Surely this is a sign of the divine.

texts.zh:
我们竭尽所能试图找出这个陶瓷容器出现在恒星轨道的原因。也许这是我们的集体幻觉？也许它根本不存在？连这些可能性我们都计算过了。但是一无所获。我们尽力了。

唯一的好处就是当我们再也无法忍受调查这东西时，我们可以慢慢研究哲学和经济问题。
texts.en:
We have tried everything in order to find out how the ceramic pot ended up in a stellar orbit. Maybe we are all crazy? Maybe it does not even exist? Guess what? We tried calculating around those facts as well! We are done. There is nothing more we can do here.

The only plus side to this is that we had tons of time to spend on philosophical and economical questions, when we could not stomach to keep investigating that damned thing.

texts.zh:
我们竭尽所能试图找出这个陶瓷容器出现在大空轨道的原因。或许我们都故障了？或许它根本就不存在？<<错误！>>连这些可能性我们都计算过了。<<错误！>>
这事儿到此为止。我们尽力了。

这项调查的一个好处就是，当我们无法容忍继续调查那个不合逻辑的罐子时，我们可以花大量的时间在理论与经济问题上。
texts.en:
We have tried everything in order to find out how the ceramic container ended up in a stellar orbit. Perhaps we are all malfunctioning? Perhaps it does not even exist? <<Error!>> We attempted to calculate around those facts as well. <<Error!>>
We are done. There is nothing more we can do here.

The one positive aspect of this investigation is that we had excessive amounts of time to spend on theoretical and economical questions, when we could not bear to keep investigating that illogical pot.

texts.zh:
在几乎要放弃继续研究这可恶的陶瓷物体时，我们终于取得了突破！该容器是一个神圣遗物，无疑是由神灵留在轨道上的信号！

该物体散发着能量，解码后终于显示出隐藏的信息：那是能够改善我们的研究能力以助我们尽早升天的信息！

现在唯一的问题是……究竟是谁发来的这道信息？
texts.en:
After almost giving up hope, studying the accursed ceramic object for so long, we have reached a breakthrough! The container is a sacred relic, left in orbit as a sign, surely from the divine!

The object is brimming with energy, which when decrypted reveals its hidden message: information on how to help us ascend by improving our research efforts!

The only question now is... who sent this message?

texts.zh:
在花了大量时间研究那个陶瓷物体却并未取得明显进展之后，我们的科学单元终于有了突破。该物体并不存在于我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]所知的三维空间中，而是一个来自更高维度的投影。

分析这个四维物体的本影让我们积累了足够的数据来解密它的信息。该物体教会我们如何在所有科研领域取得进展。

现在只剩下一个问题：是谁，或者是什么东西发送了这个信息？
texts.en:
After an extensive period of studying the confounding ceramic object without notable results, our scientific units have finally reached a breakthrough. The object does not exist in what we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] know as three-dimensional spacetime, but rather it is a projection from a higher dimension.

Analyzing it, as an umbra of a fourth dimensional object, we have accumulated enough data to decrypt its message. The object teaches us how to attain improvements in all fields of research.

Only one question remains: Who or what sent this information?

texts.zh:
在几乎要放弃继续研究这可恶的陶瓷物体时，我们终于取得了突破！该物体并非真是存在于那里，而是从更高级的维度投影下来的。分析发现，那是一个四维物体的影子，我们累积了足够的数据去解码它的信息。该物体能够改善我们对所有研究领域的认知。

现在唯一的问题是……究竟是谁发来的这道信息？

Analyzing it, as a shadow of a fourth dimensional object, we have accumulated enough data to decrypt its message. The object teaches us how to improve in all fields of research.

The only question now is... who sent this information?

label.en: Thanks to the powers that be!

texts.zh: 一个陶瓷茶壶围绕着恒星公转……这实在令人难以置信。搞清楚它是怎么形成的需要耗费很多时间。谁知道我们能否找到这个问题的答案，或者说甚至这个问题根本就没有答案？
texts.en: A ceramic pot is orbiting a sun... this is beyond improbable. Figuring out what it does there will take quite some time. Who knows what the answer will be, or if there even is one?
